entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elven planeswalker of the Gatewatch from Zendikar who follows Chandra to Kaladesh, uses aether flows to find the Dhund, and chooses to stay with her friends.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker of the Gatewatch who tries to rescue her mother and confronts her tormentor Baral.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: An older renegade inventor and old friend of Chandra's parents who leads the search through Ghirapur's night market and tunnels.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: A scarred, vicious mage who runs the secret Dhund and killed Chandra's father; he traps the three in a counterspell cell.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother, held prisoner in the Dhund.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker pursuing a different lead who told Chandra to take revenge on Baral.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepath planeswalker whose mind-link helps the Gatewatch fight together.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A strong planeswalker of the Gatewatch whom Chandra imagines beating down the door.

entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: Nissa's elemental companion, a fragment of Zendikar's world-soul.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon who disrupted the ley lines of Zendikar and tore Ashaya from Nissa.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that escaped its prison and destroyed Bala Ged.

entities.name: Mazik
entities.description: A person Nissa remembers as the last she called a friend.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: An aetherborn smuggler who runs the night market hub.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A Consulate minister who told Baral that Chandra was back.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers Nissa joined to protect other worlds.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The government of Kaladesh whose secret police run the Dhund.

entities.name: Joraga
entities.description: Nissa's people on Zendikar.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city of Kaladesh whose aether flow Nissa reads.

entities.name: Gonti's night market
entities.description: A hub for contraband aether and renegade inventors across the river, above the tunnels leading to the Dhund.

entities.name: Dhund
entities.description: A secret complex run by Baral beneath the night market, hidden behind an illusory wall.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: The home of the Joraga on Zendikar, the first place Ulamog destroyed.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nissa's home plane.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Chandra's home plane.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: The energy flowing through Kaladesh that Nissa can track.

events.summary: Mrs. Pashiri leads Chandra and Nissa to Gonti's night market, since the Dhund lies in tunnels beneath it.
events.quote: I'm told the Dhund lies in tunnels beneath the night market.

events.summary: On a skiff across the river, Nissa thinks of Ashaya and of her place in the Gatewatch.
events.quote: She thought of Ashaya then, her elemental companion, a fragment of the world-soul of Zendikar

events.summary: Chandra rejects Nissa's offer of calm and says she only wants to find her mother.
events.quote: I want to find my mom.

events.summary: Nissa works out that the way aether flows through the city can guide them to the Dhund.
events.quote: It has to do with the way aether flows through the city.

events.summary: Concentrating, Nissa perceives the plane's aether as a vast river network and tracks a trickle from underground tunnels.
events.quote: The world suddenly sprawled vast across her awareness, like a map unrolled and spread upon a table.

events.summary: Chandra melts a steel door's handle with white-hot fire.
events.quote: A blast of white-hot fire leapt from Chandra's hand to engulf the door handle

events.summary: Chandra kicks down a guard while Nissa's vines dismantle his automaton.
events.quote: Vines broke through the concrete floor and coiled around its legs

events.summary: Nissa admits she cannot find Pia directly in the tunnels.
events.quote: Finding your mother down here is another matter entirely.

events.summary: Chandra snaps at Nissa asking if she even has a mother, and Nissa reveals that Ulamog destroyed her people's home of Bala Ged.
events.quote: it was the first place he destroyed

events.summary: Chandra erupts at Mrs. Pashiri for leading them around in circles.
events.quote: You've been leading us around in circles while they have my mom?

events.summary: Chandra steps through an illusory wall and discovers it is not real.
events.quote: disappearing through the stone as if it were a wall of water

events.summary: Beyond the illusion, the tunnels become clean, well-lit corridors lined with bureaucrats' offices.
events.quote: The tunnel network was utterly transformed.

events.summary: Armored figures surround them and a scarred man, Baral, unmasks.
events.quote: One of the figures reached up and pulled off a filigree mask that covered his face.

events.summary: Chandra's firestorm is absorbed into Baral's hand device.
events.quote: the flames vanished as they reached him

events.summary: Baral raises walls that trap the three in a sealed chamber.
events.quote: she slammed into a wall that shot up from the floor

events.summary: Baral says Baan told him she was back and promises she will not escape again.
events.quote: Baan said you were back. I couldn't believe it.

events.summary: Baral calls Chandra a pathetic freak of nature and tells her to burn all she likes and die more quickly.
events.quote: You'll die more quickly if you burn up the air.

events.summary: Nissa touches Chandra's back and briefly feels Chandra's fire in her soul.
events.quote: A channel opened between them

events.summary: Chandra begs Baral to let the others and her mother go and kill only her, but he refuses.
events.quote: Kill me, just me.

events.summary: Chandra's wave of fire reflects back on her, and Nissa shields Mrs. Pashiri with her cloak.
events.quote: throwing her cloak over Mrs. Pashiri and trying to shield the older woman with her body

events.summary: Nissa realizes poison vapor is leaking into the cell to suffocate them faster.
events.quote: He means for us to suffocate more quickly after all.

events.summary: Cut off from the earth, Nissa recalls her only other equal isolation, when Ob Nixilis tore Ashaya from her (flashback).
events.quote: when the demon Ob Nixilis had disrupted the ley lines on Zendikar and torn Ashaya from her

events.summary: Nissa offers to fuel Chandra's fire with her mana to try to melt the door's hinges.
events.quote: Let me fuel your fire,

events.summary: Their focused flame fails against the counterspell and fizzles out.
events.quote: the last flames fizzling out in her hand

events.summary: Chandra tells Nissa that the Gatewatch is about not being alone and having a family on any plane.
events.quote: Having a family, no matter what plane we're on.

events.summary: Chandra refuses to leave the dying Mrs. Pashiri, and Nissa says she will stay with them, thinking of Chandra as her friend.
events.quote: I'll stay here with Mrs. Pashiri.

relations.note: The Dhund is a secret complex run by Baral.
relations.quote: a secret complex run by the vicious mage Baral
she is being held in the Dhund

relations.note: He hunted her as a child and now traps her.
relations.quote: You're pathetic, little Nalaar. A pathetic freak of nature.

relations.note: An old friend of Chandra's parents who helps search for Pia.
relations.quote: an old friend of Chandra's parents, Oviya Pashiri

relations.note: Chandra calls Nissa a good friend, and Nissa thinks of her as her friend.
Ashaya is her elemental companion and a fragment of Zendikar's world-soul.
relations.quote: her elemental companion, a fragment of the world-soul of Zendikar

relations.note: He tore Ashaya from her by disrupting Zendikar's ley lines.
relations.quote: the demon Ob Nixilis had disrupted the ley lines on Zendikar and torn Ashaya from her
It was the home of the Joraga, my people.

relations.note: Ulamog destroyed Bala Ged first when he escaped his prison.
relations.quote: it was the first place he destroyed
